signatures.title: Your signature (optional)
signatures.description: Sign now as the landlord. The lease is sealed once every party signs.
signatures.allSignedNote: If every party signs here, the contract is marked signed when saved and can no longer be edited.
signatures.tenantRemote: The tenant and co-tenants sign on their phone with a verification code. If they're with you, use "Sign in person" on the contract page after sending it.

lease.parties: On one side, the LANDLORD; and on the other, {tenants}, hereinafter the TENANT. Both parties agree as follows:

property.title: Property
property.body: The LANDLORD leases to the TENANT the property {name}, located at {address}

term.title: Term
term.body: The lease will last {hasMonths, select, yes {{months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}} other {__________}}, from {start} to {end}.

rent.title: Rent
rent.body: Monthly rent will be {rent}, payable no later than day {day} of each month.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.body: The TENANT provides a deposit of {deposit}.

lateFee.title: Late fees
lateFee.fixed: If rent is not paid on time, starting on day {day} of the month a late fee of {fixed} will be charged.
lateFee.daily: If rent is not paid on time, starting on day {day} of the month a late fee of {daily} will be charged for each day late.
lateFee.both: If rent is not paid on time, starting on day {day} of the month a late fee of {fixed} will be charged, plus {daily} for each day late.

occupants.title: Occupants
occupants.body: The property will be occupied by {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

keys.title: Keys
keys.body: The TENANT receives {count, plural, one {# key} other {# keys}}.

parking.title: Parking
parking.body: Includes {count, plural, one {# parking space} other {# parking spaces}}

items.fan_count: {count, plural, one {# ceiling fan} other {# ceiling fans}}
items.stool_count: {count, plural, one {# bar stool} other {# bar stools}}

law.title: Governing law
law.pr: This contract is governed by the 2020 Puerto Rico Civil Code.
law.us_mainland: This contract is governed by the laws of the state where the property is located.
law.other: This contract is governed by the laws of the jurisdiction where the property is located.
